SELECT
  ts AS time,
  num_value AS pm1
FROM
  reading_value
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND station = 'mstn-2b'
  AND source = 'particulates'
  AND section = 'values'
  AND key = 'pm1_ugm3'
  AND ts_src <> 'estimated'
ORDER BY
  ts

-- Highest value in the last 24 Hours
SELECT
  max(num_value) AS pm1
FROM
  reading_value
WHERE
  ts > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND station = 'mstn-2b'
  AND source = 'particulates'
  AND section = 'values'
  AND key = 'pm1_ugm3'
  AND ts_src <> 'estimated'
